spec_match.rationale: Every lane is a real setHTML() call; the non-spec removeUnknownMarkup key and the "deny URL protocols" claim are gone, and the lede lists the real SanitizerConfig members.

interactive.rationale: Six examples, a live JSON policy editor and input-driven re-sanitisation update three lanes and the meters on every keystroke.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Removal meters now come from a multiset diff of elements and of attributes on surviving elements, not positional indexes.

edge_cases.rationale: Strict lane explains, and can toggle, replaceWithChildrenElements; a permissive custom config (script + onclick allowed) still yields no script and no handler; invalid config and invalid JSON are announced; unsupported browsers get inert text, not a walker imitation.

references.rationale: Links the HTML Standard section instead of the retired WICG draft.

conformance.rationale: Unchanged immutable suite (7/7 pass on Chrome 158, mostly existence checks; its specUrl still points at the retired WICG draft). New behavioural facts verified on Chrome 158 that a human could add as a NEW suite: setHTML with elements:["script"] and attributes:["onclick"] still drops both; elements:[] deletes wrapped text; elements+removeElements throws TypeError; the default drops .

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 158.0.8127.36 via Node Playwright on the local server, at 360x740 DPR3 touch and 1280x800, plus a run with Element.prototype.setHTML/Sanitizer deleted before load to exercise the unsupported path. chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment, so this is NOT DevTools-MCP verification (rule 7b); DOM semantics were checked by script. All six examples, the strict toggle, permissive/invalid/bad-JSON configs driven; 0 console errors, 0 failed requests, no handler ran.

telemetry_health.rationale: The capability check now calls window.showcaseTelemetry.support() with supported/unsupported, on top of the shared runtime capture. No interaction events.

design_system.rationale: Uses variables; on desktop the three lanes are still narrow for long serialised HTML.

accessibility.rationale: Labels associated, errors role=alert, support note role=status, meters are labelled <output>s, checkbox wrapped in its label.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800; buttons >= 44px; the checkbox hit area is its 44px label.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify with chrome-devtools-mcp and inspect the accessibility tree
openQuestions.detail: The 2026-11-24 fix pass also used Playwright (Chrome for Testing 158) because chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in the cloud environment.

guidanceConsulted.query: associated labels, toggle buttons with aria-pressed, status messages for sanitizer results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Associate every <label> via for/id, expose toggle state with aria-pressed on native buttons, and announce results with role=status / <output>.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: labels for every textarea, preset cards became buttons with aria-pressed, role=toolbar on the editor toolbar, role=status on support notes and logs, <output> meters.

guidanceConsulted.query: minimum touch target size for buttons on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Size targets from a --target-size token (24px, 44px under pointer: coarse) with min-block-size; size the label for checkboxes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied to all buttons; the strict-lane checkbox sits inside a 44px label. 0px overflow at 360x740.

summary: Fixed 2026-11-24: real setHTML()/Sanitizer behaviour only (no regex or walker imitation in unsupported browsers), accurate SanitizerConfig usage including replaceWithChildrenElements, real before/after diffs, HTML Standard references, and accessible native controls.
